title: CYNDY Dashboard workflow
brief: A 360 px Android-first static Dashboard prototype using only existing local facts: welcome, start-count action, latest saved count with separate currency totals, record statistics, and safe access to history and settings.

artboards.title: Dark Spanish Dashboard and light English Dashboard
artboards.tradeoff: Makes the local start-and-review workflow immediately scannable while keeping per-currency totals separate instead of introducing a converted aggregate.
